CORE PRINCIPLE: THE BIRTH OF THE BELL CURVE
Single dice have flat uniform distributions (each face is 1/6). But when two dice add
extreme sums require extreme coordination, while central sums have many different additive
This combinatorial clustering is the foundation of the normal distribution Bell Curve!
